overview_description.description:
Vinculum is a SaaS omnichannel software company enabling 

Brands to Sell on multiple marketplaces, 
Brands and Retailers to go Omni-channel
Brands and Retailers to go Direct to consumer ( D to C)
Brands to set up marketplaces
Brands to scale internationally with an uberized network of brand distributors
We work with brands like P & G, Jockey, Fossil, Bata, Harman Electronics, Titan, Skechers, Body Shop, Nykaa, Swiggy, Blue Dart, DHL, LF Logistics, DTDC,  Dairy Farm Group and are backed by Accel Partners and Ivycap Ventures.

about_short_description.short_description: Vinculum is a market leader in enabling Multi/ Omni Channel Retailing and fulfillment with Industry leading SaaS OMS, WMS products.

product.name: VIN OMS (Order Management System)
product.description: A SaaS platform to manage and streamline omnichannel order processing and fulfillment across multiple sales channels and locations.

product.name: VIN WMS (Warehouse Management System)
product.description: A warehouse management system to automate and optimize warehouse operations for B2B and B2C order fulfillment across various industries.

product.name: VIN PIM (Product Information Management)
product.description: An AI-powered multilingual product information management system to centralize, manage, and distribute product data across multiple sales channels.

identifier.value: VIN OMNI (Offline and Online Retail Management)

product.name: VIN OMNI (Offline and Online Retail Management)
product.description: A platform to manage inventory and fulfill B2B and B2C orders from a centralized inventory pool across offline and online retail channels.

product.name: VIN RECO (Marketplace Payment Reconciliation)
product.description: An AI-enabled solution to identify and reconcile payment discrepancies and profit leakages from marketplace transactions.
